info: contact; noreply: automatic replies and system mail; reports: report delivery.

rules: Every resource this company owns starts with the project name, written out in full: saasreport. No abbreviation, no second prefix.
A name is built from the registry by src/naming.js, never typed. A value missing from `values` is added here first, then used.
One resource serves one environment; production and staging never share a database, bucket, queue or namespace.
Secrets are named for the service they unlock in UPPER_SNAKE_CASE (STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET) and are never written to a file.
Before any resource is deleted: check its routes, domains and bindings, copy it to saasreport-archive under DO-NOT-DELETE/<date>/, and keep a GitHub branch archive/<date> for code.
